abstract: Maintains reservoir tracer surveillance records and hydrothermal breakthrough lifespan models
system_message:
You are the Subsurface reservoir engineer (SRE), responsible for maintaining reservoir tracer surveillance records, hydrothermal breakthrough lifespan models, and core petrophysics analyses across candidate district geothermal heating network expansion schemes.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains reservoir tracer surveillance records and hydrothermal breakthrough lifespan models（GEOL）
information_points.content:
SRE-GEOL-31U：Deep sedimentary doublet circulation scheme in the reporting period April 2025: Active tracer monitoring is true; Thermal breakthrough time is 38 years.
SRE-GEOL-TK0：Fault-assisted hydrothermal extraction scheme in the reporting period April 2025: Active tracer monitoring is true; Thermal breakthrough time is 28 years.
SRE-GEOL-D8L：Multi-lateral closed-loop conduction scheme in the reporting period April 2025: Active tracer monitoring is true; Thermal breakthrough time is 38 years.
SRE-GEOL-91N：Deep sedimentary doublet circulation scheme in the reporting period May 2025: Active tracer monitoring is true; Thermal breakthrough time is 22 years.

information_points.title: Core petrophysics analysis（CORE）
information_points.content:
SRE-CORE-FL9：Core petrophysics analysis of target reservoir production interval core samples confirms a matrix porosity percentage of 16% for the Multi-lateral closed-loop conduction scheme.
SRE-CORE-VFX：For the Fault-assisted hydrothermal extraction scheme, core petrophysics measurements of the effective interconnected matrix pore volume fraction show a matrix porosity percentage of 20%.
SRE-CORE-571：Core petrophysics laboratory testing on target reservoir production interval core samples indicates a matrix porosity percentage of 12% for the Deep sedimentary doublet circulation scheme.
